name: Ivo
title: Keeper of the Greenstair
examine: Sunburnt at altitude, soil to the wrists. Talks to the wheat rows in a tone most people save for children and dogs.
lines: Farming a mountain is just farming, plus stairs.
The lowlands get two harvests and no view. I get one harvest and *this*. I've done the arithmetic; I'm ahead.
Snow in the morning, sun by noon, wind with opinions all day. The Greenstair grows stubborn food for stubborn people.
